card.name: Digits inside numbers and lists
card.fires_on: A single digit token inside a longer number, year, table value, or reference number, often the first digit of a list or section number. It appears in tables, dates, citations and numbered lists.

modes.label: Digit in decimals/tables
modes.description: A digit after a leading zero in small decimal table values.

modes.label: Digit in years or ranges
modes.description: A digit within a year or page-range number.
modes.example: 8 - Edna Czech 1912 - 2003 - Joseph Czech 1891 - 19<<6>>8 - Max Czech 19

modes.label: Item or reference number
modes.description: A digit starting a numbered item or figure or reference number.
modes.example: Pre-filled Syringe Pre-filled Syringe-Figure <<1>>: Pre-filled Syringe-Figure

card.plain: It fires on single digits within numbers such as years, table values and list numbers.
